source_artifact.content_excerpt:
Installed Orchestrate 3.0.6 and current main at bf66ee5e declare dependencies as a JSON object.
The live Claude plugin loader requires an array and rejects the entire plugin, so Orchestrate does
not load and its /orchestrate command is unavailable. This blocks starting the Auralis orchestration.
Reproduced with claude plugin validate against both the repository source and the installed cache.
The smallest fix is to express the same agent-launcher >=1.0.0 floor as an array of objects.
